description: The campaign will host a primary election night watch party at the Robbinsdale Entertainment Center in Rapid City on Tuesday, June 2. Doors open at 5:30 PM MT and the event is open to the public and the press.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Marty Jackley for Congress
title: Jackley to Host Election Night Watch Party in Rapid City — Marty Jackley for Congress
